title: Golden Gate Zipper
description:
Watch on Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/reel/CLXjzZjp5zA/?igshid=1r9rhvxyjyj17
The way SF changes lanes on the GG Bridge is so interesting. It inspired me to get weird and make this video. 
Its called a BTM. A barrier transfer machine, also known as zipper machine or road zipper, is a heavy vehicle used to transfer concrete lane dividers, such as jersey barriers, which are used to relieve traffic congestion during rush hours.
